about.title: 会社概要
about.description: 臨沂発のOEM互換建設機械パーツ。部品番号照合、臨沂在庫、青島での通関と海上輸送。東南アジア・中東・アフリカの鉱山とフリート向け。
about.lead: 建設機械・重機の輸出供給。東南アジア、中東、アフリカの鉱山、工事請負、輸送フリート向けにOEM互換パーツとワンストップ調達を提供します。
about.whatTitle: 精密照合、機種をカバー
about.what: 部品番号と図面で機種に合わせて照合し、誤品と稼働停止を減らします。
about.whereTitle: 在庫を確保、迅速に対応
about.where: 臨沂を拠点に摩耗部品とパワートレインを在庫し、注文に応じてピッキングします。
about.how: 青島での通関、混載またはフルコンテナ。船便、経路、コンテナ種別はお問い合わせ時に確定します。
about.close: 品質優先、正確な出荷、グローバル対応。海外の鉱山と重機フリートへ長期供給。問い合わせに営業が返信します。

contact.title: お問い合わせ
contact.description: WhatsApp、電話、Facebook、またはRFQ。部品番号照合と海上混載。
contact.lead: 照会フォームにご記入いただくか、電話・WhatsApp・Facebook・メールで営業へご連絡ください。
contact.rfqDesc: 種類を選び、銘板写真を添付し、WhatsAppで送信します。

shipping.title: 配送ポリシー
shipping.description: Dispatch from Linyi, sea freight via Qingdao or land freight. Sailings, container type, and charges are confirmed on inquiry.
shipping.lead: Warehouse release, packing, and transit are stated separately on the quote. The notes below are typical; the confirmed quote governs.
shipping.s1Body: Parts are checked by part number, picked, and packed in Linyi. In-stock items are released to the inquiry.
shipping.s2Body: Export customs and stuffing via Qingdao Port, LCL or FCL. Destination, container type, and sailing are confirmed on inquiry.
shipping.s3Body: After release, truck or rail can be arranged. Routing and handover are confirmed on inquiry.
shipping.s4Body: Freight, insurance, and clearance follow the trade terms on the quote. This site does not publish a rate sheet.

payment.title: 支払いポリシー
payment.description: Payment is agreed on the quote. Linyi Songyu does not post bank details on this website.
payment.lead: Method, currency, and schedule are agreed after the quote is confirmed.
payment.s1Body: Talk to sales on WhatsApp, phone, or email. Payment terms are written on the quote.
payment.s2Body: Bank details are sent only on a formal quote or written confirmation. Do not pay unknown accounts claiming to be Songyu.

privacy.title: プライバシーポリシー
privacy.description: How Linyi Songyu uses inquiry contacts and part numbers.
privacy.h1: プライバシーポリシー
privacy.lead: Information sent with an RFQ is used to quote and follow up. It is not sold.
privacy.s1Body: 照会には部品番号、機種、数量、連絡先、および送信される銘板の写真や動画が含まれることがあります。
privacy.s2Body: We use it to match parts, reply with a quote, and continue the conversation. A language cookie may be stored in the browser.
privacy.s3Body: WhatsApp, phone, and email run under their providers’ rules. We do not sell inquiry lists.

terms.title: 利用規約
terms.description: Terms for using the Linyi Songyu catalog, RFQ, and quotes.
terms.lead: This site shows parts and receives inquiries. A sale follows the quote both sides confirm.
terms.s1Body: 製品ページは照会用です。仕様は部品番号と書面確認に従います。OEM互換は純正OEMではありません。
terms.s2Body: An RFQ is not an order. Price, quantity, lead time, and freight follow the quote confirmed by sales.
terms.s3Body: 写真と動画は機種の識別に使います。現物は合意した仕様に従います。
terms.s4Body: Using this site means you accept these notes. Disputes are discussed first. The laws of the People’s Republic of China apply.
